capabilities: Store strokes in a JSON sidecar
Merge annotations into a flattened PDF
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Handwrite annotations on PDFs in Obsidian with your Apple Pencil.
motivation: I built this to annotate musical scores during rehearsal with our vocal band: things like breath marks, "watch out for thise note", etc.
problem: The difficulty of annotating PDFs while maintaining the integrity of the original file for version control or syncing.
summary: A PDF annotation tool that allows users to handwrite notes using an Apple Pencil, storing strokes in a JSON sidecar to keep the original PDF unmodified.
